system.description: You have access to a mortal who looks just like you — a twin sister, a long-lost relative, someone Vicissituded to the resemblance, or simply a very good actor. Unless ghouled, your fetch ages normally and will eventually cease to double for you. She can move about during the day, conducting your business and maintaining your semblance of a mortal life, but she also commits actions for which you remain responsible; keep her carefully informed of your relationships and dealings, or she may create problems rather than solve them.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
